template_data.lead_html: The cert gets you in the room. It doesn't hand you the contract.

rows.what_html: The cert IS the pipeline — get certified, contracts follow
Opens set-aside solicitations — but a vehicle and cap statement still required
Stack the cert on a GSA Schedule — that's how the award actually lands

template_data.closer: THE CERT IS THE TICKET. THE WORK IS THE RIDE.
